answer: Cosignatures are collected in shale, verified in lagoon, and opal names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 26 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 85 dollars and 6 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
